svg.text: Turret Node 160 x 110 x 75 IP65 on P5
Valve train on P5 (regulator, valve, meter)
1. Call 811 before digging. Footing Ø150 x 650, one 20 kg bag fast-
set concrete; crown the top to shed water.
2. Plumb the post in two directions. Post top 924 above grade puts
3. Node box and valve train sit on the side away from the lawn; pan
